name: Change of Pace Attack
summary: Use speed changes off the dribble to beat your defender to the rim and to your jumper, then hold that pace while tired.

drills.name: Stop-Start Dribbling
drills.summary: Learn to go from full speed to a dead stop and back without losing the ball.
steps: Dribble from the baseline toward half court at 50% speed.
Every 3-4 dribbles, stop hard on two feet with the ball still alive.
Hold the stop for one dribble with your eyes up.
Push out again at full speed with a long first step.
Go down and back with your right hand, then your left.

drills.name: Slow-Fast Layups
drills.summary: Lull the defender with a slow dribble, then explode past them to the rim.
steps: Set a cone at the top of the key.
Walk the ball to the cone with a slow, high dribble.
At the cone, drop your hips and explode toward the rim.
Finish with the outside hand off the glass.
Alternate sides each rep: right side right hand, left side left hand.

drills.name: Shot Fake One-Dribble Jumper
drills.summary: Sell the shot, take one hard dribble and rise into a balanced jumper.
steps: Start on the wing in triple threat, about 15 feet out.
Give a quick shot fake with the ball at your forehead.
Take one hard dribble to the side.
Plant both feet, square up and shoot.
Make 4 going right, then 4 going left, then switch wings.

drills.name: Speed Change Intervals
drills.summary: Hold your handle and your pace changes while your legs get tired.
steps: Start on the baseline with the ball.
Dribble to the free-throw line at 50%, then sprint to half court.
Jog the dribble to the far free-throw line, then sprint to the far baseline.
Walk 10 seconds to recover, then come back the same way.
Keep going until the timer ends. Switch hands every trip.
